panels.title: Recent quality upgrades
panels.description:
Files replaced by a **different** quality, newest first.

An upgrade is two events at the same instant: the old file deleted with reason `Upgrade`, and the
new one imported. Same quality on both sides means it was a custom-format score upgrade, not a
resolution change.

**Colours follow the download policy, not the resolution:**
🔵 4K · 🟢 what the TV direct-plays (Bluray/WEB 1080p) · 🟠 works but wastes space (Remux-1080p, 720p)
· 🔴 unwanted (BR-DISK, cams, SD)

panels.title: Upgrades tracked
panels.description: How many upgrades this exporter is currently exposing (capped at the last 25).

panels.title: Reachable
panels.description: Whether the exporter can talk to qBittorrent's WebUI at all.

panels.title: Torrents in error
panels.description: `error` or `missingFiles`: the data is unreadable or has been moved out from under qBittorrent. These never finish on their own.

panels.title: Stalled downloads
panels.description: Torrents that want to download but find no seeds. One for hours usually means the release is dead; let Radarr blocklist it and grab another.

panels.title: Torrents
panels.description:
**qBittorrent states**

| State | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| `downloading` | pulling data right now |
| `metaDL` | fetching the .torrent metadata (magnet just added) |
| `stalledDL` | wants to download but finds no seeds: stuck |
| `queuedDL` | waiting for a download slot |
| `uploading` | sending data to someone right now |
| `stalledUP` | seeding, but nobody is downloading from you. Normal for old titles |
| `queuedUP` | finished, waiting its turn to seed. **Not seeding at all** |
| `pausedUP` / `stoppedUP` | stopped on purpose, or its share limit was reached |
| `checkingUP` / `checkingDL` | verifying pieces against the disk |
| `moving` | being moved between folders |
| `error` / `missingFiles` | broken: the data is unreadable or gone |

Why so many queued: `MaxActiveTorrents = 18` with 36 torrents, so half wait their turn.

panels.title: Disk by quality
panels.description:
Space per quality, straight from Radarr, so the quality
is the real one and not a guess from the filename.

Same colour scheme as the upgrades table: 🔵 4K · 🟢 good · 🟠 wasteful · 🔴 unwanted.

panels.title: Disk usage by folder
panels.description:
Top-level folders on the data disk, from
`du --max-depth=1`, which counts each inode once per run. A hardlinked file therefore lands in
whichever folder du walks first instead of being counted twice.

panels.title: Biggest titles (top 20)
panels.description:
Largest titles in the library, with the quality
that explains the size. Radarr is the source, so this counts the imported file once even when it is
hardlinked to a torrent in downloads/.

panels.title: All tracked files (raw — full paths, filterable)
panels.description:
The 30 largest files on
the data disk, one line per **inode**.

The *arrs hardlink on import, so a grabbed file and its library copy are the same bytes under two
paths. Listing both would double-count the footer total, so the library path is kept and the
downloads one dropped.
